config.nearest: per cloud, the minimum over the training maps; per map, the mean over its clouds

reading: 7 of 10 variants place every unseen arena above their own training floor; SW2 (unweighted) (12 of 13); SW2 to the pooled corpus (11 of 13); Frechet to the pooled corpus (9 of 13) do not. A training map's own validation clouds sit above the floor maximum under Gaussian KL(target||source) (22.479 against 22.393); kNN KL(source||target) (52.671 against 51.418). The largest rank correlation of any variant with any of the four outcomes is +0.46 (D (motion-weighted SW2) against gain, p = 0.12, n = 13); none of the 40 variant-outcome pairs reaches p < 0.05. Against D, the other variants rank the arenas with Spearman +0.51 (Gaussian KL(source||target)) to +0.99. Dropping the motion weights moves D by at most 0.006 on the arenas (their spread is 0.152) and ranks them with Spearman +0.99 against the weighted D, but moves the floor's maximum from 0.093 to 0.124. The strongest link of any variant to the model's zero-shot skill S0 is -0.23 (kNN KL(target||source)).
